holdout.note: the only causal read: arms assigned by hash on 2026-08-19 from buckets 00-3; 'advanced' = current bucket rank > rank at assignment. The hold arm is n=40, so any lift under ~10 points is inside the noise.

recommendations.title: Fix and restore report-call-b56, then raise its per-run cap
recommendations.why: 23 bookings on 321 sends Aug–Oct (71.7/1k), most of them report calls — the only call type that predicts a listing. It was FAILING on 2026-11-10.
recommendations.change: ~/.openclaw/agents/reportcall-b56.sh: RC_CAP 25→40 (RC_DAILY_MAX stays 50); first clear the exit-2 failure and check calendar_booked.txt age
recommendations.expected: ~28.7 bookings/week at 40/run x 2 runs x 5 days if supply exists (b5/b6 is finite: re-touches dominate after week 1)
recommendations.risk: b5/b6 converts by phone, not email; repeat touches to the same 60-70 owners; enforce the 5-day cross-engine gap

recommendations.title: Keep consult-inspection at volume; split first touch from re-touch
recommendations.why: 27 bookings on 822 sends Aug–Oct (32.8/1k) — the largest absolute booker.
recommendations.change: ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.belong.inspection-adoption-enqueue.plist: keep INSPECTION_CAP=200; lower COOLOFF_DAYS 14→10 only for owners with touch_n<=2
recommendations.expected: current ~1.6/week at the last-30d pace; +~1/week from the shorter cool-off
recommendations.risk: double touches against apmg/consult (5-day gap), opt-outs from re-touched signed owners

recommendations.title: apmg-t1 is the best rate in the book: widen supply, not the cap
recommendations.why: 25 bookings on 325 sends Aug–Oct (76.9/1k). Cap is not binding.
recommendations.change: ~/.openclaw/agents/apm-google-enqueue.sh: APMG_SOURCES add remaining inbound sources (e.g. facebook, referral); APMG_CAP unchanged at 80
recommendations.expected: each +10 first touches/week ~ +1 booking/week at this rate
recommendations.risk: Intercom consent + current-customer check on every new source; t1 opens cold, which reads badly to a just-called signup

recommendations.title: Cut drain-backfill tier B
recommendations.why: 11 bookings on 4841 sends Aug–Oct (2.27/1k) — the bulk of volume, almost none of the bookings.
recommendations.change: ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.belong.outreach-drain.plist: add DRAIN_BACKFILL_TIER_B=0 (tier A fresh leads keep flowing)
recommendations.expected: ~0 bookings/week lost; removes ~20-60 re-touches/day and their opt-out/bounce exposure
recommendations.risk: drain idles when the queue is empty — that is the honest state

recommendations.title: Keep funnel-cadence disabled; apmg-t2/t3 on watch
recommendations.why: funnel-cadence t2–t6 booked ~0 on its sends; re-touch rates collapse after touch 1 (see first_touch_vs_retouch).
recommendations.change: leave com.belong.funnel-cadence.plist.disabled; review apmg-t2/t3 in enqueue_apm_google.py (touch tiers) against their per-1k

caveats: bookings come from engagement_signals + calendar_booked.txt matched on email and name; 278 distinct bookings since 2026-06-01, 142 had a sent email in the 21 days before the call, 136 did not (organic/inbound or booked under an address we never emailed); 43 name-only bookings never resolved to an address.
booking dates are the CALL date, not the date the owner clicked the link, so a send between booking and call can collect the credit (inflates every lane slightly).

replies = inbound Gmail replies only; 553 'CRM: replied/asked for callback' flags are excluded because the snapshot has no inbound/outbound direction. Replies include declines and auto-replies that slipped the filter.
advanced / agreements_after / inspections_after use the CRM's CURRENT-cycle *_effective_dt dates only; a milestone that was later reset or re-cycled is lost.

bucket_at_send = bucket in the nearest dated CRM snapshot at or before the send (<=7 days old; snapshots start 2026-07-08), else the holdout bucket_at_assign, else null. Most cold/backfill recipients are not in Gabriel's book and read null.
replies_pending_answer = Gmail replies in the last 7 days with no later send to that address; a phone answer or hand reply outside the send log is invisible here.
per-1k figures beside n < 100 sends are marked too_small and should not be read.
November is partial (through the generation date) and the lanes were down 2026-11-06 to 11-10 for the dashboard-cookie outage.
